[[File:酉の市Torinoichi000.jpg|thumb|{{ill|Tori-no-Ichi|ja|酉の市|1=Tori-no-Ichi|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tori-no-Ichi|13=User:Immanuelle/Tori-no-Ichi|qq=}}の{{ill|Rake (tool)|en|Rake (tool)|qid=Q200822|lt=Kumade|1=Rake (tool)}}]]
'''Ōtori Shrine''' (大鷲神社, also pronounced Ōwashi Shrine) refers to a name for various {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine|1=Shinto shrine}} across Japan. These shrines are part of the {{ill|Ōtori faith|ja|大鳥信仰|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori faith|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}}, with {{ill|Ōtori taisha|en|Ōtori taisha|qid=Q705151|lt=Ōtori taisha|1=Ōtori taisha}} as their main shrine. Many are related to other shrines with similar names, such as {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|lt=Ōtori Shrine|lt=Ōtori Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=}}, {{ill|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=}}, and {{ill|Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲宮神社 (曖昧さ回避)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=}}. Several are also widely known for hosting {{ill|Tori-no-Ichi|ja|酉の市|1=Tori-no-Ichi|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tori-no-Ichi|13=User:Immanuelle/Tori-no-Ichi|qq=}} festivals. There are seven such shrines officially recognized as religious corporations nationwide.

For related terms, see {{ill|Ōtori Shrine|lt=Ōtori Shrine|lt=Ōtori Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|大鳥神社 (曖昧さ回避)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=}}, {{ill|Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Washi Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=}}, {{ill|Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|鷲宮神社 (曖昧さ回避)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Washi-no-Miya Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=}}, and {{ill|Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|ja|日鷲神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ame-no-Hiwashi Shrine (disambiguation)|qq=}}.

* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Tsukuba)|ja|大鷲神社 (つくば市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (Tsukuba)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Tedegaki, Tsukuba City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Ichikawa)|ja|大鷲神社 (市川市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (Ichikawa)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Takaya, Ichikawa City, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Ichihara)|ja|大鷲神社 (市原市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (Ichihara)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Yanagihara, Ichihara City, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Narita)|ja|大鷲神社 (成田市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (Narita)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Kitahatori, Narita City, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Sakae)|ja|大鷲神社 (栄町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (Sakae)|qq=}} - Located in Anjō, Sakae Town, Inba District, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Shisui)|ja|大鷲神社 (酒々井町)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (Shisui)|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid}} - Located in Kamiiwahashi, Shisui Town, Inba District, Chiba Prefecture.
* {{ill|Ōtori Shrine (Adachi Ward)|lt=Ōtori Shrine (Adachi Ward)|lt=Ōtori Shrine (Adachi)|ja|大鷲神社 (足立区)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Ōtori Shrine (Adachi)|qq=}} - Located in Hanahata, Adachi Ward, Tokyo. Known as the origin of Tori-no-Ichi.
* Ōtori Shrine - Located in Miyamachi, Fuchū City, Tokyo. A subsidiary shrine of {{ill|Ōkunitama Shrine|en|Ōkunitama Shrine|qid=Q611678|lt=Ōkunitama Shrine|1=Ōkunitama Shrine}}.
* Ōtori Shrine - Located in Makane-chō, Minami Ward, Yokohama City, Kanagawa Prefecture. Consolidated into the precincts of a {{ill|Kotohira shrines|lt=Kotohira shrines|lt=Konpira Shrine|ja|金刀比羅神社|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konpira Shrine|comment=enwiki is a redirect}} (see {{ill|Konpira and Ōtori Shrine|ja|金刀比羅・大鷲神社|1=Konpira and Ōtori Shrine|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Konpira and Ōtori Shrine|13=User:Immanuelle/Konpira and Ōtori Shrine|qq=}}).
